items.title: Boost Run Announces Date of Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call
items.summary: NORTHBROOK, Ill., November 05, 2026--Boost Run, Inc. (Nasdaq: BRUN), an NVIDIA Preferred Cloud Partner operating in adherence with NVIDIA Reference Architecture standards, plans to release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, pre-market on Thursday, November 12, 2026. The company plans to host a conference call at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss its third quarter 2026 results.

items.title: Mary Tyler Moore Vision Initiative Welcomes Regeneron and Adaptive Sensory Technology to Its Consortium
items.summary: The Mary Tyler Moore Vision Initiative (MTM Vision) today announced that Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. has joined the MTM Vision Consortium as a founding member and Adaptive Sensory Technology as a device company member.

items.title: Deloitte named a Leader in IDC MarketScape Worldwide AI-enabled Adobe Professional Services 2026 Vendor Assessment
items.summary: Deloitte has been positioned as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape Worldwide AI-Enabled Adobe Professional Services 2026 Vendor Assessment (Doc #US54114626, October 2026). Deloitte is recognized as a "worldwide services provider that combines a long heritage in business consulting with broad and deep IT services capabilities, and with a strong understanding of its clients' business on multiple levels." Deloitte's Adobe-focused professional services are delivered through Deloitte Digital.

items.title: Scout Clean Energy’s Nimbus Wind Farm Achieves Commercial Operations, Supporting Microsoft’s Clean Energy Portfolio
items.summary: 183 MW Wind Facility is Now Largest in the State of ArkansasGREEN FOREST, Ark., Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Scout Clean Energy (“Scout”), a leading North American renewable energy developer-owner-operator, announced today that its 183 MW Nimbus Wind Farm (“Nimbus”) in Carroll County, Arkansas is now commercially operational. This achievement marks the culmination of two years of construction on the project, which is now generating enough electricity to power more than 40,000 homes annually
